entities.name: sciatic nerve chronic constriction injury neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: Potamogeton perfoliatus extract
relationships.object: sciatic nerve chronic constriction injury neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with the extract significantly attenuated mechanical and cold allodynia and heat hyperalgesia with better potential than the reference drug, pregabalin.

relationships.subject: Potamogeton perfoliatus extract
relationships.evidence_quote: After 14 days of the surgery, our results revealed increased COX2 and PGE2 levels in the sciatic nerve and brainstem, which were both suppressed by the extract at the two sites by the end of the experiment.

relationships.subject: Potamogeton perfoliatus extract
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect on PGE-2 was dose dependent, and the high dose of the extract was shown to be superior to pregabalin.

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Recruited hematogenous macrophages at the injured sciatic nerve upregulate the expression of COX-2 leading to increasing the production of PGE2 that contributes to the inflammatory response

key_findings: P. perfoliatus extract attenuated CCI-induced allodynia/hyperalgesia better than pregabalin and reduced PGE2, COX-2, TNF-alpha, NF-kB, 5-LOX in sciatic nerve and brainstem
Extract reduced glial activation, apoptosis (Bax) and oxidative stress (NOX-1) while raising Bcl-2 and catalase
